item.title: Musk Claims $40 Billion Chips Debt Closed, Yet Talks Ongoing
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: Elon Musk said SpaceX has closed a $40 billion debt deal to pay for the chips it needs to fuel its artificial intelligence ambitions. People familiar with the discussions, though, told Bloomberg News that talks over pricing were still ongoing. “SpaceX closed $40B of debt for GPUs,” Musk wrote in a post on X, referring to Nvidia Corp.’s graphics processing units.
